items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had Joe, John Johnson-- I had a bass player that played bass and played piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, uh-huh. And myself on the trumpet. And then one time, before I had this lady, as my pianist, I had -- I would have different men that I would give the job to. I had Joe, John Johnson-- I had a bass player that played bass and played piano.
